lead.description: a follow-up of a defined group in which exposure is recorded and later outcomes are counted

overview_sentence: A [cohort study](articles/cohort-study.qmd) follows a defined group and compares later outcomes by exposure.

self_checks.title: Risk ratio
self_checks.prompt: Of 80 exposed people, 20 develop the outcome. Of 120 unexposed people, 12 do. What is the risk ratio?
self_checks.answer: The risks are 0.25 and 0.10, so the risk ratio is 2.5.

self_checks.title: Extra exposed
self_checks.prompt: The exposed group becomes 21 outcomes among 84 people, and the unexposed risk stays 0.10. What is the risk ratio?
self_checks.answer: The exposed risk is 0.25, so the risk ratio is still 2.5.
